column1: # Ourania ephemeris corpus (J15) - GENERATED, and generated deliberately.
# WHAT THIS IS: the positions this build answers for a fixed set of charts,
# so that a change to the ephemeris path shows up as a diff instead of as a
# chart that is quietly a little different. 12 instants from 1500 to 2450 x 5 places from the equator to 78N.
# WHAT THIS IS NOT: an accuracy corpus. These numbers came from this build;
# checking them against it proves only that nothing has moved. The assertions
# that test whether the sky is RIGHT are in EphemerisCorpusCheck, and they are
# invariants - the tropical year, the synodic month, the sidereal periods -
# which are true of the sky rather than of this program.
# THE SOURCE COLUMN MATTERS AS MUCH AS THE LONGITUDE. 'files' is the Swiss
# Ephemeris data; 'approximation' is the built-in Moshier fall back, which is
# close enough that nobody notices it happening; 'error' is a point the chart
# does not get at all. A row moving from files to approximation is the defect
# this file exists to catch.
# A derived point - an angle, a lot, the south node - is labelled
# 'derived', because no ephemeris call answers it; 'houses' is the four
# angles the house call returns.
# Regenerate with:
#   java -cp "src\main\java;lib\*" com.zodiacomputing.ourania.astro.EphemerisCorpus --overwrite-the-expectations
# Houses: P.  Zodiac: tropical.  Settings: a fresh install's defaults.
